reasons.food_preparation_mismatch: The preparation doesn’t match a reference used for this estimate.

reasons.unsupported_serving_conversion: This household measure has no verified weight for this food. For future logs, use edible grams if known.
reasons.nutrient_data_missing: The food reference is missing one or more nutrient values.
reasons.unknown: Some information was insufficient for this estimate.

log.intro: Record what you actually ate, in your own words.
log.unavailable: Food logging is available only in local development. This page cannot save records here.
log.local: Local development only. Records are stored on this machine.
log.example: For example, steamed egg and a bowl of rice.
log.manualHelp: Add at least one food item by hand. If you enter a description, it’s saved separately. Leave quantities blank if you don’t know them.

ai.help: Optional. Recognition sends your description to Gemini for suggestions. You can also enter the items yourself.
ai.applied: AI suggestions added. Review and edit the items before saving a draft.
ai.stale: The description changed after recognition. Review the items against the new text or run recognition again.
ai.pending: Review the suggestions below. Your current items stay in place until you choose to replace them.
ai.empty: No foods could be identified. Add items manually or revise your description and try again.

portions.quantity_unspecified: No quantity was found. Leave it blank if you don’t know it.
portions.portion_needs_review: The portion is unclear. Check it and enter a quantity only if you know it.

notes.description_needs_review: Part of the description was unclear. Check for missing or incorrect items.
notes.image_needs_review: Some foods in the photo were unclear. Review the suggested items.

errors.input: Enter a food description of up to 2,000 characters, then try recognition again.
errors.unavailable: AI recognition is unavailable. Check the local backend and its Gemini configuration, or enter foods manually.
errors.provider: AI recognition couldn’t produce a valid proposal. Try again or enter foods manually.
errors.timeout: AI recognition took too long. Try again or enter foods manually.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach the recognition service. Check the local backend and try again.
errors.invalid: The recognition result was invalid. Try again or enter foods manually.
errors.format: Choose a still JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.size: This photo exceeds the 5 MiB upload limit or the supported dimensions.
errors.corrupt: This photo could not be read. Choose a different image.

photo.label: Meal photo
photo.help: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MiB. The photo is sent to Gemini only when you request recognition.
photo.uncertain: Food identification is uncertain. Please check the name.

log.name: Food name
log.empty: No food logs for this date.

log.editing: Save or cancel your corrections before confirming or deleting this log.

notices.create: Draft saved. Review it below and confirm once it reflects what you ate.
notices.update: Draft corrected. Review it below before confirming.

errors.conflict: This log changed or was deleted. Records are reloading. Review the latest version before trying again.
errors.unavailable: The food log API is unavailable. Check that the loopback backend is running in development mode.
errors.items: Enter a name for each food item. At least one food item is required.
errors.invalid: Check the food names, date, and quantities, then try again.
errors.time: Enter a valid local date and time. If clocks skip this time, choose another time.
errors.quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero, or leave it blank.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach the food log API. Check the local backend and try again.
errors.saveUnknown: Couldn’t verify that the draft saved. Reload the records for the consumption date before saving again.
